name: Palworld-Wine-Server
description: Community-maintained Unraid template for ripps818's Palworld Dedicated Server running the Windows server under Wine. Includes documented REST API, backups, Workshop authentication, and optional UE4SS settings; no mods are bundled.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Persistent Palworld installation, configuration, saves, backups, and mods.

paths.name: Steam Session Cache
paths.description: Persists the Steam Guard login token used for authenticated Workshop downloads.

ports.name: Game Port
ports.description: Public Palworld gameplay port. Forward this UDP port through your router for Internet players.

ports.name: REST API Port
ports.description: Palworld REST API used by container management, player detection, and safe announcements. Do not router-forward this port.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: Unraid user ID used for files in appdata.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Unraid users group ID used for files in appdata.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: IANA timezone used for logs, backups, and scheduled jobs.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown to players.

variables.name: Server Join Password
variables.description: Optional password players enter when joining. Do not reuse the admin password.

variables.name: Admin / REST API Password
variables.description: Required private password for Palworld administration and REST API Basic Auth. Use a strong unique value.

variables.name: Maximum Players
variables.description: Maximum concurrent players. Increase only when the host has sufficient CPU and memory.

variables.name: Community Server Listing
variables.description: Set true to advertise the server in Palworld's community server list.

variables.name: Crossplay Platforms
variables.description: Platforms allowed to connect.

variables.name: Server Settings Mode
variables.description: auto: template environment variables control settings. manual: edit PalWorldSettings.ini and most game-setting variables are ignored.

variables.name: REST API Enabled
variables.description: Required by current container management, player detection, safe backup announcements, and restapicli.

variables.name: REST API Internal Port
variables.description: Must match the REST API container port mapping.

variables.name: RCON Enabled (Deprecated)
variables.description: Deprecated by current container tooling. Leave false unless using an external legacy RCON client.

variables.name: Multithreaded Server
variables.description: Enables the upstream multithreaded dedicated-server launch options.

variables.name: Backups Enabled
variables.description: Creates server backups in the persistent /palworld directory.

variables.name: Backup Schedule
variables.description: Supercronic expression. The default creates one backup every hour.

variables.name: Backup Retention Enabled
variables.description: Automatically removes old backups beyond the configured count.

variables.name: Backups to Keep
variables.description: Number of server backups retained when retention is enabled.

variables.name: Player Detection
variables.description: Logs joins and leaves and supports webhooks. Requires the REST API.

variables.name: Update Server on Start
variables.description: Checks and installs Palworld Dedicated Server updates whenever the container starts.

variables.name: Validate Steam Files
variables.description: Validates game files on startup. Validation can overwrite direct modifications to upstream game files.

variables.name: Automatic Update Checks
variables.description: Periodically checks for game updates and can restart after an announced countdown.

variables.name: Workshop Mod IDs
variables.description: Optional comma-separated Steam Workshop Published File IDs.

variables.name: Workshop Update Schedule
variables.description: Supercronic expression for Workshop update checks; default is every six hours.

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Optional Steam username for paid Workshop content. Authenticate interactively once and use the persistent Steam cache; do not store STEAM_PASSWORD here.

variables.name: Install Experimental UE4SS
variables.description: Downloads and deploys the upstream Palworld-specific experimental UE4SS framework for compatible server mods.

variables.name: Allow Client Mods
variables.description: Allows clients using supported client-side mods to connect.
